info.name: FinOps Foundation FOCUS Cost and Usage API
FinOps Foundation List cost and usage records

params.name: billingPeriodStart
params.description: Filter by billing period start date (inclusive). Format is date-time per RFC 3339.

params.name: billingPeriodEnd
params.description: Filter by billing period end date (exclusive). Format is date-time per RFC 3339.

params.name: chargeCategory
params.description: Filter by charge category (e.g., Usage, Purchase, Tax, Credit, Adjustment).

params.name: providerName
params.description: Filter by the name of the entity that made the resource or service available.

params.name: serviceName
params.description: Filter by the display name of the service that was purchased.

params.name: serviceCategory
params.description: Filter by the highest-level classification of a service (e.g., Compute, Storage, Networking, Database).

params.name: region
params.description: Filter by the isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: Filter by unique identifier assigned to a resource by the provider.

params.name: subAccountId
params.description: Filter by the identifier for a sub account.

params.name: billingCurrency
params.description: Filter by the currency that a charge was billed in.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of records to return per page.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves FOCUS-compliant cost and usage records. The response conforms to the FOCUS Cost and Usage dataset schema, providing normalized billing data with standardized columns for dimensions and metrics.

info.name: FinOps Foundation Export cost and usage data

items.docs: Initiates an export of FOCUS-compliant cost and usage data for a specified billing period. Returns a job identifier that can be used to check the status and retrieve the exported data.

info.name: FinOps Foundation Get cost and usage export job status

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier for the export job.

items.docs: Retrieves the status of a previously initiated cost and usage data export job.

info.name: FinOps Foundation List contract commitment records

params.name: commitmentDiscountId
params.description: Filter by the identifier assigned to a commitment discount by the provider.

params.name: billingAccountId
params.description: Filter by the unique identifier for a billing account.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of records to return per page.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves contract commitment records as defined in the FOCUS v1.3 supplemental dataset. Contract commitments isolate contract terms such as start and end dates, remaining units, and descriptions from cost and usage rows.

info.name: FinOps Foundation Get FOCUS schema metadata

items.docs: Retrieves metadata about the FOCUS dataset schema, including column definitions, data types, FOCUS version, and data generator version information.
